mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id, c.user_id, c.conversation_type, c.target_id, c.target_name, COALESCE(u.avatar, c.target_avatar) as target_avatar, c.last_message_id, c.last_message_content, c.last_message_time, c.unread_count, c.total_count, c.is_pinned, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.target_id = u.user_id AND c.conversation_type = 1 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.is_pinned DESC, c.last_message_time DESC

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.user_id, c.conversation_type, c.target_id, c.target_name, COALESCE(u.avatar, c.target_avatar) as target_avatar, c.last_message_id, c.last_message_content, c.last_message_time, c.unread_count, c.total_count, c.is_pinned, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.target_id = u.user_id AND c.conversation_type = 1 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND ( c.target_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR MATCH(c.target_name) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ) ORDER BY c.is_pinned DESC, c.last_message_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unread_count), 0) FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_type = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unread_count), 0) FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_type = 2
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, last_message_content = #{lastMessageContent}, last_message_time = #{lastMessageTime}, unread_count = #{unreadCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
